# AWS Backup

Persist regional vaults, immutable backup-plan versions and resource-selection metadata without running backups.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `backup` |
| Signing name | `backup` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2018-11-15` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 17 of 115 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-backup) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: no schedule execution, resource membership scan, IAM role existence/trust or permission checks, KMS lookup/key creation/encryption, data protection, backup/restore/copy jobs or recovery points.
- StartBackupJob and job/recovery-point List/Get APIs, vault locks, notifications and access policies, reports, legal holds, organization policies, cross-account runtime and scheduling previews are absent.
- Plans reject AdvancedBackupSettings, ScanSettings, copy/index/scan actions, continuous backups, air-gapped targets, timezone and archive-opt-in lifecycle members; unsupported members fail explicitly even when set to false or empty arrays.
- Cron metadata uses the existing parser: six UTC fields with ranges/lists/steps; rate expressions and L/W/# cron syntax are rejected. Omitted schedules default to cron(0 5 ? * * *).
- Lifecycle supports days 1-36500 with cold storage at least 90 days before deletion; omit DeleteAfterDays for indefinite retention. Start windows support 60-52560000 minutes, completion windows 1-52560000.
- Selections reject wildcards, NotResources and Conditions; role/resource ARNs are shape-validated commercial references only and are not resolved; ListOfTags is stored OR-selector metadata without matching resources.
- Plan names are unique among active plans and support 1-200 alphanumeric/dash/underscore/dot characters; vault names 2-50 without dots, rule/selection/token names 1-50. Plans retain up to 2000 versions; at most 300 vaults and 300 active plans per account/Region.
- Supplied CreatorRequestId tokens contain 1-50 alphanumeric/dash/underscore/dot characters. Replays return the original create result even after a plan update; vault/selection tokens are removed with their records, plan tokens remain with deletion history.
- No fabricated default vault or KMS key: create target vaults explicitly; EncryptionKeyArn is absent when omitted. Vault deletion is permitted when empty even if a plan references it.
- CloudFormation supports BackupVaultName/BackupVaultTags/EncryptionKeyArn, BackupPlan/BackupPlanTags and BackupSelection/BackupPlanId; policy, lock, notifications and all other properties are rejected. Vault name/key changes and selection changes require replacement; no mutation console.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateBackupPlan` | `PUT /backup/plans` |
| `CreateBackupSelection` | `PUT /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}/selections` |
| `CreateBackupVault` | `PUT /backup-vaults/{BackupVaultName}` |
| `DeleteBackupPlan` | `DELETE /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}` |
| `DeleteBackupSelection` | `DELETE /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}/selections/{SelectionId}` |
| `DeleteBackupVault` | `DELETE /backup-vaults/{BackupVaultName}` |
| `DescribeBackupVault` | `GET /backup-vaults/{BackupVaultName}` |
| `GetBackupPlan` | `GET /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}` |
| `GetBackupSelection` | `GET /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}/selections/{SelectionId}` |
| `ListBackupPlanVersions` | `GET /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}/versions` |
| `ListBackupPlans` | `GET /backup/plans` |
| `ListBackupSelections` | `GET /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}/selections` |
| `ListBackupVaults` | `GET /backup-vaults` |
| `ListTags` | `GET /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /tags/{ResourceArn}` |
| `UntagResource` | `POST /untag/{ResourceArn}` |
| `UpdateBackupPlan` | `POST /backup/plans/{BackupPlanId}` |
